brms's dfrechet() takes the Frechet scale and the row passes shape = 1; frmtmb's frechet(), like brms's frechet family, takes the mean mu = scale * gamma(1 - 1 / nu), which is infinite at shape <= 1, so there is no frmtmb parameter for it. The shim refuses the call (brms_g1_frechet_dp()) rather than hand the density mu = Inf, on which brms's length-only assertion would hold over NaN values. At shape 3 the same shims agree with brms's pfrechet() to 1.1e-16 (distributions:95 and its value check)
